fees.info: Payable when you ask us to produce the title to you or another credit provider

fees.name: TITLESEARCH
fees.info: Payable when you undertake a title search in relation to any security

fees.name: SETTLEMENTATTFEE
fees.info: Payable when we are required to attend any settlement on your behalf

fees.name: SEARCHFEE
fees.info: Payable when we undertake any search in relation to your company or business at ASIC

fees.name: PROGPAYMENT
fees.info: Payable on the 8th and any subsequent drawdown on a construction loan

fees.name: PHOTOCOPYFEE
fees.info: $3 per page. Payable when you ask us to photocopy documents for you

fees.name: DISCHARGE_FEE
fees.info: Payable when any security is wholly or partially discharged.

fees.name: REDRAW
fees.info: Payable each time you request a redraw on your loan over the counter. For all loans apart from Interest Saver loans, this fee is waived for the first redraw req

fees.name: CONSENT_FEE
fees.info: Payable when you ask us to consent to a second mortgage on any security

fees.name: DEFAULTFEE
fees.info: Payable on the last day of each month during which there is an amount overdue for payment on your loan.

fees.name: AGENT_FEE
fees.info: Payable if we need to instruct an agent in connection with the settlement of your loan

fees.name: CHQFEE
fees.info: Payable for each cheque required on settlement in excess of five (5) cheques

fees.name: DUPLICATESTATEMENTFEE
fees.info: Duplicate Statement Fee - $2 per page of statement produced. Payable when you ask us to produce duplicate statements for you.

fees.name: LEGALCOSTS
fees.info: Priced on application - Payable when we pay our solicitors as a result of your application for a variabtion to, discharge of or our consent to any variation of

fees.name: SECURITYSEARCH
fees.info: Priced on application - Payable if we need to search a register in relation to any security

fees.name: VALFEE
fees.info: Priced on application - Payable when we have to pay a valuer as a result of your application for our consent to any matter relating to this agreement or the sec

fees.name: CONTRACTVARIATIONFEE
fees.info: Payable in the event we agree to vary your loan agreement

fees.name: DISHONOURFEE
fees.info: Payable if a direct debit from another account to your loan is declined or a cheque deposited to your loan account is dishonoured

fees.name: SWITCHFEE
fees.info: Payable when you convert from one interest rate option to another. This fee is in addition to any break costs payable

eligibility.info: Applicable for a Loan to Value Ratio (LVR) of 80.01-90.00%

eligibility.value: Must be an Australian resident or citizen, with an Australian residential mailin

eligibility.info: Product is available to approved borrowers only. Terms, conditions, fees, charges and normal lending criteria apply

fees.name: TITLESEARCH

fees.name: SETTLEMENTATTFEE

fees.name: SEARCHFEE

fees.name: PROGPAYMENT

fees.name: PHOTOCOPYFEE

fees.name: DISCHARGE_FEE
fees.info: Payable when any security is wholly or partially discharged.

fees.name: REDRAW
fees.info: Payable each time you request a redraw on your loan over the counter. For all loans apart from Interest Saver loans, this fee is waived for the first redraw req

fees.name: CONSENT_FEE

fees.name: DEFAULTFEE
fees.info: Payable on the last day of each month during which there is an amount overdue for payment on your loan.

fees.name: AGENT_FEE
fees.info: Payable if we need to instruct an agent in connection with the settlement of your loan

fees.name: CHQFEE
fees.info: Payable for each cheque required on settlement in excess of five (5) cheques

fees.name: DUPLICATESTATEMENTFEE
fees.info: Duplicate Statement Fee - $2 per page of statement produced. Payable when you ask us to produce duplicate statements for you.

fees.name: SECURITYSEARCH
fees.info: Priced on application - Payable if we need to search a register in relation to any security

fees.name: VALFEE

fees.name: CONTRACTVARIATIONFEE
fees.info: Payable in the event we agree to vary your loan agreement

fees.name: DISHONOURFEE
fees.info: Payable if a direct debit from another account to your loan is declined or a cheque deposited to your loan account is dishonoured

fees.name: SWITCHFEE
fees.info: Payable when you convert from one interest rate option to another. This fee is in addition to any break costs payable
